test_title: SSC Steno 2022 Official Paper (Held On: 18 Nov 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
‘P % Q’ means ‘P is the brother of Q’.

‘P @ Q’ means ‘P is the daughter of Q’.

‘P + Q’ means ‘P is the father of Q’.

‘P ? Q’ means ‘P is the husband of Q’.

If A % B @ D + E ? C, then how is A related to C?
solution:
Family Chart:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a776c0a19b6706031165c847bcb98978a1e150482bd1260c12a74559ea55407.png] 

Decoding the Symbols:

 
 

 Symbol
 %
 @
 +
 ?
 
 

 Meaning
 Brother
 Daughter
 Father
 Husband
 
 

 

Given: A % B @ D + E ? C

It means: A is the Brother of B, B is the Daughter of D, D is the Father of E, E is the Husband of C.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a4c05487fa0f9d810ac2c422933b48fe6a71d8b066f3c556cedc2785b18765bb.png] 

Here, A is the 'Husband's Brother' of C.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
